privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {legalName} (“AGXORA”, “we”, “us”) processes personal data when you visit {siteUrl}, create an account, or use the AGXORA platform.
privacy.dataAccount: Account data: name, email, organization, and role.
privacy.dataUsage: Usage data: product interactions, device, and diagnostic logs.
privacy.dataBilling: Billing data: plan, invoices, and payment references from providers.
privacy.dataSupport: Support communications you send to us.
privacy.purposesBody: We process data to provide the service (contract), secure the platform (legitimate interest), meet legal obligations, and—where required—with your consent (for example optional analytics or marketing).
privacy.retentionBody: We retain personal data only as long as needed for the purposes above, including statutory retention for billing and security records, then delete or anonymize it.
privacy.sharingBody: We use vetted processors (hosting, email, payments) under appropriate contracts. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.yourRightsBodyBefore: Depending on your location, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or objection. Contact
privacy.yourRightsBodyAfter: You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
privacy.cookiesBodyAfter: for details on essential and optional cookies.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern access to and use of AGXORA products and websites operated by {legalName}. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these Terms.
terms.accountsBody: You must provide accurate registration information, keep credentials secure, and are responsible for activity under your account. Organization administrators manage seats and access for their workspace.
terms.billingBodyBefore: Paid plans are billed according to the plan selected on
terms.billingBodyAfter: Enterprise agreements may supersede self-serve terms. Fees are non-refundable except where required by law or expressly agreed in writing.
terms.useNoMisuse: Do not misuse the platform, attempt unauthorized access, or disrupt service.
terms.useNoUnlawful: Do not upload unlawful content or infringe third-party rights.
terms.useCompliance: Comply with export, sanctions, and industry regulations that apply to you.
terms.customerDataBodyBefore: You retain rights to your business content. You grant AGXORA a limited license to host and process that content solely to provide the service. Our
terms.aiFeaturesBody: AI outputs may be inaccurate or incomplete. You remain responsible for reviewing outputs before relying on them for business decisions.
terms.availabilityBody: We aim for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. We may update features and these Terms; material changes will be communicated through the product or email where appropriate.
terms.liabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, AGXORA is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our aggregate liability for paid subscriptions is limited to fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy describes how {companyName} uses cookies and similar technologies. Essential cookies are required for authentication and security. Optional analytics cookies are enabled only where consent is collected.
cookies.whatAreBody: Cookies are small files stored on your device. They help the site function, remember preferences, and—where allowed—measure performance.
cookies.essentialBody: authentication, security, load balancing, and basic preferences. Required for the service.
cookies.functionalBody: optional features such as remembered UI settings (when enabled).
cookies.analyticsBody: aggregate usage measurement (only with consent where required).
cookies.managingBody: You can control non-essential cookies through browser settings and, once available, our on-site preference center. Blocking essential cookies may prevent sign-in or core product use.
